line_item_extractions.text:
Standard includes:
Upfront assistance, receipt of mail,
weight count of mail, perform drawing,
generate and reproduce winners list, labels,
preparation of tax reporting information,
and storage of entries. Includes up to 20
hours of Program Management time;
1-1.000 prizes and up to 100.000 entries.

-Over 1.000 prizes, $0.25/additional prize
will be billed for drawings which do not have
all entries keyed.

On-Premise Events includes:
Upfront assistance, generate and reproduce
winners list, labels, preparation of tax
reporting information, and storage of
entries. Includes up to 10 hours of
Program Management time.

Official Rules includes:
Up to 12 hours YA time.

- Additional legal review time - $300/hour
(billed at actual).

($100 FL. $100 NY. $150 RI)

($120.00 each)
